title: TraceEvent
description: A single step execution event in the tracer timeline.

step_index.description: The sequential index of this execution step (0-based).

file.description: The absolute or relative path to the source file being executed.

line_number.description: The 1-based line number in the source file.

source_line_text.description: The actual text of the source line being executed.

variables.description: A map of local variable names to their stringified values at this step.
